summary: Folder switch with more panes than the 12 GPU slots: counts WebGL contexts made and disposed and slots live; shown panes get the GPU within SWAP_AFTER_MS from the panes hidden longest, with no extra churn.

tests.name: LAG-08 GPU slots > a folder switch into a full pool: within SWAP_AFTER_MS every shown pane draws on the GPU and the folder hidden longest gives its slots
LAG-08 GPU slots > switching back to a folder that kept its slots makes no context and releases none; the next switch evicts the folder hidden longest
LAG-08 GPU slots > a quick look at another folder (shown under SWAP_AFTER_MS) evicts nobody and makes no context
LAG-08 GPU slots > 20 panes, 12 slots, folders of 6/6/6/2: each switch moves only the slots it needs, from the panes hidden longest
